unit_definitions.characters_without_whitespace: sum(not c.isspace() for c in text)

extractor.whole_text: pypdf6.13.0 exact page.extract_text() return, full physical pages joined by one newline; visitor reconciliation helper binds inserted whitespace without modifying returned extraction.

extractor.calibrated: Actual font dictionary/effective encoding/encoded event and embedded outline bound for every substituted glyph; no BaseFont-only identity. Preserve spaces, discretionary hyphens, formula order and source mathematical errors. No OCR/math rewriting.

symmetric_program_rule.written_manuscripts: Concrete executable/pseudocode listings excluded from BOTH sides. All mathematical definitions, presentations and written algorithmic arguments retained. F010 accepted source absence screen reused; complete L126 and current U/R1/R2 screening is bound before final input freeze.
symmetric_program_rule.optional_validation: All nine whole optional programs remain outside manuscript comparisons on both sides; they are not conditional proof premises.

symmetric_program_rule.code_appendix: All16 pages, containing ten whole files, counted separately. Never combined additively with the same whole raw files. Mandatory graph JSON is separate and never replaced by a summary or by this appendix.
symmetric_program_rule.reason_software_unavailable: Source software and full retained proof/data costs are not established under a matched representation; unknown is not zero.
